subject: How to solve the Error in parse: <text>:2:0: unexpected end of input.

messages.author: bed7c1348ff0ff5f
messages.subject: How to solve the Error in parse: <text>:2:0: unexpected end of input.
parts:
Dear all,

When I use the following coding, I meet the Error in parse: <text>:2:0: unexpected end of input. I debug and find that it may come from the yellow part. I guess the error is related to shiny r, but I don't know how to solve it. Men may I ask if you have any idea about it?

 datasetInput <- reactive({
    
    gen <- blacklistPop()
    
    if(input$mlgCollapse =='Yes'){
      
      mlg.filter(gen, distance = "bruvo.dist",replen=rep.length) <-as.numeric(input$mlgCollapseThreshold)
      mll(gen) <- "contracted" # from mg.filter
    } 
    
    gen <- setPopulation.fn(gen)
    
    return(gen)
  })
  
  blacklistPop <- reactive({
    gen <- setPopulation()
    if(input$popsubsetRadiobutton=='Yes'){
      if(!is.null(input$popblacklist)){
        gen <- popsub(gen,blacklist=input$popblacklist)
      }
    }
    return(gen)
  })
  
  setPopulation <- reactive({
    gen <- getRawData()
   
    pop.structure <- input$populationSelection
    if(is.null(pop.structure)){return(gen)}
    setPop(gen) <- as.formula(paste0("~",pop.structure))
    return(gen)
  })
  setPopulation.fn <- function(gen){
    pop.structure <- input$populationSelection
    if(is.null(pop.structure)){return(gen)}
    setPop(gen) <- as.formula(paste0("~",pop.structure))
    return(gen)
    
  }

dataset <- datasetInput()
pop.structure <- input$clonecorrectionAnalysis
strata <- as.formula(paste0("~",pop.structure))
dataset1 <- clonecorrect(dataset,strata)
    
aa <-  poppr(dataset1)
